html:
President of Liberia from 1920 to 1930, who resigned after a League of Nations inquiry found that officials had shipped forced labourers to the Spanish island of Fernando Po.

The 1930 commission found that men of the interior were rounded up by the frontier force and sent abroad in conditions it compared to slavery, and that Vice President Allen Yancy was involved. Both King and Yancy resigned. The scandal led to talk of putting Liberia under League control, which its government resisted. It exposed how the settler elite treated the native majority. King had also signed the Firestone agreement of 1926.
sum: President of Liberia from 1920 to 1930, who resigned after a League of Nations inquiry found that officials had shipped forced labourers to the Spanish island of Fernando Po.
